title: Live from Your 5th House, Ep. 2
old_caption: Phone away, a question for the quiet friend, a name remembered on the first try, laughing with you, not at you. How a date treats your people tells you a lot about how they'll treat you.

title: Your date is meeting your friends
old_caption:
Your date facing your friends can feel like a talent show with judges. Then your date asks how the friends met, and every score turns to a heart.
They just want to see you treated well.

title: Our Stars Met First
old_caption:
Two stars meet before their humans do. First awkward small talk, then they discover they're both fire.
The spark isn't really about a face. It's about what you share. Let the connection come first.

title: Our Stars Met First, Ep. 2
old_caption: A five-year planner and a dream journal. Never late and never on time. On paper, nothing matches. But the right person doesn't try to fix you. They help you grow, and you help them too.

title: The Mime.
old_caption:
Gemini tries hearts in the air, an invisible box and a rope. Taurus guesses everything except "I like you."
Nobody can read your mind. Saying it plainly is braver, and much clearer.

title: Mission Control.
old_caption:
A whole mission control debating a three-hour rule and whether a heart is too eager, while the reply just sits there.
They weren't counting the minutes. Text back when you want to. Games get boring fast.

title: Your Moon sign knows.
old_caption:
Know your Moon sign, not just your Sun?
Your Sun is who you show, your Moon is what you need. Date someone who meets both.

title: Leo: The Musical.
old_caption:
Leo writes a full musical about a two-second chat at the coffee cart. Then the crush walks by and all that comes out is "hi."
Good news: they said hi back. You don't need a grand gesture, just a simple hello.

title: Even stars get a name.
old_caption: Four months in, you ask "what are we?" and hear "I don't do labels." Wanting clarity isn't too much. It's okay to say what you want early and mean it.

title: The Relationship Olympics.
old_caption:
Synchronized "fine" texts, a stuck compromise relay, a who-was-right high jump. Nobody wins when couples compete.
You're on the same team. Love feels best when you cheer each other on.
